subject.title: Session bloat: skillsSnapshot and systemPromptReport accumulated on every run

question: What durable `systemPromptReport` policy should OpenClaw use for retained session entries without reintroducing warning-dedupe or diagnostics regressions?
rationale: The source-level bug is clear, but choosing between active-only retention, truncation, out-of-line storage, or a minimal dedupe summary changes durable session metadata semantics and upgrade behavior.

options.title: Persist Minimal Durable Summary
options.body: Keep only the warning-dedupe and small diagnostic fields needed across restarts, and drop or externalize large `tools`, `skills`, and injected-file arrays from retained rows.

options.title: Out-of-line Full Reports
options.body: Store full reports by content hash or session-scoped artifact and keep `sessions.json` as a lightweight index with explicit cleanup ownership.

options.title: Active-only Inline Reports
options.body: Keep full reports only for active/current sessions and strip them from stale entries during maintenance or write-time compaction.

recommendation.title: Persist Minimal Durable Summary
recommendation.body: Keep only the warning-dedupe and small diagnostic fields needed across restarts, and drop or externalize large `tools`, `skills`, and injected-file arrays from retained rows.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle introduced the report metadata and later authored the adjacent prompt-blob dedupe mitigation, making them the strongest routing candidate for the persistence policy choice.
